parsed.explanation: The dossier documents an actively enforced same-sex criminalisation statute (2017 code, overwhelming legislative support, a pre-code prosecution with prison sentences) plus explicit state failure to protect: police and prosecutors refuse to investigate crimes against LGBTQ+ people, with civil society alleging imprisoned people under pretext charges. Society is documented hostile (15% acceptance; framing as threat to family), with no discrimination protection and thin recourse — tier 2/3 exposure: state-tolerated vulnerability plus societal hostility with no remedy. Offsetting: no trans-specific offence, no documented universal-exposure measure (facilities, custody, border), no trans-specific violence statistics, no organised targeting of gender-nonconforming people, and no documented visitor-facing document check. Resident gaps (no LGR, voter/housing denial) are climate signals only. Criminalisation plus non-protection keeps it out of Reduced Risk despite the absence of trans-specific violence records.
